name: Coffee
summary: The drink the town is known for, served black or with milk. Cafes run from plain rooms to formal ones.
origin: Bao Dak Lak on 10 Feb 2021 names cà phê as the drink of Buon Ma Thuot, beside the local dishes.
howToEat: Order it black or with milk. A counter at the head of Bà Triệu mixes the cup with a glass of ice cream.
where: Nguyen Chi Thanh, the garden cafes in Ako Dhong, and the head of Bà Triệu.
seoTitle: Coffee in Buon Ma Thuot — black or with milk
seoDescription: Coffee in Buon Ma Thuot, black or with milk, from plain rooms to garden cafes in Ako Dhong.
